vb_textbox.text: I believe what helped me best was sticking with one at first for a few tries; for example, my favourite was key K. I originally began with this key and only changed to S if the mushroom count was 1/2/0. I think that many mushrooms were mostly in K, that's where I found mine. My advice would be just to quickly click one of the keys and think whether more will come through, I went with K if I got 5 or more mushrooms and then switched it back. Not too sure if that was the strategy that I was following, but it seemed to help me get many mushrooms. Also not to think about it too much, you do not have long so it has to be an initial reaction and press a key, remember that this time limit also repeats for the basket too. You need as many as possible so being slow is not an option.
